y-m-32-06.material: Thola insalela uma u-f(x)=x²⁰−3x+2 (x amandla angu-20 kukhishwe 3x kwengezwe 2) ihlukaniswa ngo-x²−1. U-f(x)=(x²−1)·Q(x)+R(x), futhi u-Q(x) uyi-polynomial enama-coefficient aphelele. Abafundi abahlanu basebenzise izindlela ezihlukile. Indlela A: Bhala u-R(x)=ax+b, faka u-x=1 no-x=−1 ukuthola u-f(1)=a+b no-f(−1)=−a+b, futhi uthole u-a no-b. Indlela B: Thatha u-x²=1, shintsha u-x²⁰=(x²)¹⁰=1, futhi ucabange u-f njengolingana no-−3x+3. Indlela C: Njengoba u-f(1)=0 no-f(−1)=6, thatha isilinganiso samanani amabili, u-3, njengensalela. Indlela D: Qhubeka nokuhlukanisa okude kwedigri o-20 kuze kube sekugcineni. Indlela E: Njengoba u-f(1)=0, kuhlukaniseka ngo-x−1, ngakho cabanga ukuthi kuhlukaniseka nangu-x²−1 futhi uthathe insalela ibe ngu-0.
